assets.notes: ART-143 H06 decision (owner, 2026-08-06): upstream's MIT grant is accepted as the licence basis for this file, explicitly accepting the residual risk that a16z-infra may not have held every right it purported to grant. ART-143's primary-source investigation could not attribute the art to a named artist, pack or generator: upstream has exactly two commits touching the texture (a41c22089 'New 32x32 spritesheet' 2023-08-12T16:52:25Z and dca78f5ea 'New 32x32 characters' 2023-08-12T21:40:38Z, PR #54, both by 61cygni, five hours apart and an entirely different cast at the same 384x256 layout), and neither commit, the PR body nor its review comment names a source; upstream's README credits a third-party source for every other art category it ships but names none for the character spritesheet; the PNG carries no author, copyright or generator metadata (only sRGB, an eXIf orientation tag, pHYs and boilerplate Adobe XMP); upstream issue #202 asked where the textures come from and the maintainer answered with a directory path only; and no visual or catalogue match was found against candidate 32x32 packs (Pipoya, OpenGameArt CC0 sets, itch.io and RPG-Maker-style packs). This record is therefore an accepted risk, not a provenance finding -- if the original artist is later identified, revisit it. MIT requires the upstream copyright and permission notices to travel with the file; ASSETS-LICENSE.md carries them.
